title: Planner closes only missing child links already hidden by explicit parent list or removed row decisions
steps: Run run.cmd without a server or provider calls. The exact published Boxing social block is combined with the passing checker fixture.
Verify all eight tests execute with zero failures or skips.
expect: The original missing block-171.6 link fails R10b before normalization; an explicit hidden parent closes it and the full checker has zero failures.
Missing visible links, ambiguous row ownership and contradictory parent decisions still fail; no target is invented.
Non-leading kept rows, explicit links and explicit row content remain intact; invalid row counts never imply hides.
Whole-plan answers and fix-round changes use the same idempotent expansion without mutating their inputs.

tests: a hidden social parent closes its missing child link without a model round
a visible undecided child link remains a checker failure
trimmed social rows close missing links but preserve explicitly named non-leading rows
explicit links and row content remain intact even when a row count is smaller
negative or fractional row counts never imply hiding links
a fix-round change receives the same hidden-parent closure
ambiguous row ownership and contradictory parent decisions stay unresolved
a page-local kept block closes its hidden row, while dropped pages remain untouched
